similarly_named_nonreplacement.rationale: This is the existing budget_router (v1) module. No evidence establishes it as the required budget_router_v2 source, so its bytes were not copied under a v2 path.

limitations: The scope covers all 33 branches returned by the repository branches API at audit time, their 53 reachable commits, untruncated recursive trees at each branch HEAD, and the eight named repository-relative path histories.
No claim is made about deleted or unreferenced branches, unreachable commits, external/private artifacts, or files present only on the original execution machine.
Path/name search and named-path commit histories do not prove absence of a semantically equivalent implementation under an unrelated name.
The git/trees response obtained using a commit SHA echoed that ref in its top-level sha field. Actual tree object SHAs in this manifest come from each commit's commit.tree.sha.
No missing source was synthesized; no v1 implementation was substituted; no experiment or remote write was performed.
reproduction_implication: The repository evidence does not supply these four frozen source dependencies. An execution path importing or hash-checking them must fail with an explicit missing-source status until the original bytes are provided.
